versions.changelog:
v1.7.0
- Value-atom preservation: a lone port (5433), issue ref (#4821), version (v2.13.0), ISO date, or hyphenated code now survives compression as its own atom — even when its surrounding line is dropped. New regression: test/value-survival.test.mjs.
- Corrected the documented config defaults (maxCapsuleTokens 700 → 1400, capsuleTokenRatio 0.08 → 0.14) to match the shipped values.
- Reframed the fidelity figures as measured on your own private sessions via test/fidelity-bench.mjs (reproduce on your data), not a repo fixture.

v1.6.0

• Lane-change awareness — when a session pivots ("use Y instead of X"), the
  capsule marks the abandoned direction as superseded and keeps the live one,
  so the model never wanders back into a dropped plan. On the held-out pivot
  set: 83% of abandoned subjects cleaned, zero live choices wrongly flagged.

• Dense-atom fidelity — file paths, IDs, ports, URLs, commands, errors and
  decisions are emitted as compact atoms: 79% of key signals kept at ~5×
  reduction, 93% at ~3.4×.

• Defense-in-depth secret redaction — API keys, JWTs, PEM blocks, basic-auth
  URLs and DSNs are redacted before compression and again on output, each with
  a one-way SHA-256 fingerprint so the same key stays correlatable across turns
  without ever exposing its value.

• Injection quarantine — instruction-injection patterns in older history are
  wrapped as inert untrusted text, never surfaced as a live instruction.

• Self-contained — no runtime dependencies, no network/filesystem/on-chain
  calls, fully deterministic. Ships prebuilt and dependency-free: drop it in,
  no build step.

Made the skill fully self-contained: vendored the compression core inline (zlib + SHA-256 only) and removed the external @parad0x_labs/context-capsule dependency. No network, file-system, or on-chain access. Tightened the plugin description with explicit when-to-use / when-not-to-use guidance. Removes the "unresolved external package" that drove prior audit Review outcomes.
Pin context-capsule dep to exact 1.0.0 — removes ^ range, fixes SkillSpector supply-chain flag.

Security: fix fail-open vault — compression error fallback now returns
vault-scanned (redacted) messages instead of raw originals. Secrets/PII
can no longer leak to the model if compression throws.

Operator visibility: compression failures now emit a console.warn with
the error message so fallbacks are never silent.

Resolves both SkillSpector medium findings from v1.2.0 audit.

- Vault scan now applied to ALL message paths: short sessions, verbatim tail, and compressed history. Previously only older messages were scanned (fixes SkillSpector Finding 1 - Intent-Code Divergence)
- README: added explicit warnings about compression fidelity loss, system-message injection, vault scan coverage limits, and dependency provenance (fixes SkillSpector Finding 2 - Missing User Warnings)

- Add inline vault-scan gate: strips API keys, tokens, credentials, PII, and card numbers from all message content before compression (addresses SkillSpector Medium finding)
- No matched values are logged — only category counts
- Add plain-English data handling disclosure to SKILL.md

- Initial release: compresses agent session history by 99.3% before sending to LLMs.
- Retains last 10 messages verbatim; earlier history is compressed into a 60-token capsule.
- Maintains high memory accuracy (answers 30/30 questions correctly on benchmark).
- Compatible with Claude, GPT, Ollama, Mistral, LM Studio, and more.
- Significant token and cost savings per call; continuous benchmarking ensures efficiency.
